notes.ja: 持ち時間: 15分＋1手ごとに10秒（国際チェス連盟の世界ラピッド選手権と同じ）
notes.en: Time control: 15 minutes + 10 seconds per move (the same as the World Rapid Championship of the International Chess Federation)

notes.ja: 白の人が双方の使えるオンラインの対局サービスで、相手を招待するリンクを作って送ります
notes.en: The White player creates an invite link on an online chess service that both players can use, and sends it

notes.en: Set the colors (White and Black) and the time control exactly as shown on this screen
